name: TapeLabelStyle
src_typeComment: Measuring Tape tab: click points in the Scene view to measure distances between them — each segment labelled at its midpoint, any number of points (A-B-C-D...). Middle-click clears (left as the normal camera-orbit button; right-click stays free for Unity's own Scene view context menu / fly-look).  Re-housed from its former standalone window into this hub, behaviour unchanged: level design is a mode of working, and measuring a gap, checking a prop isn't sunk into the stairs, and stepping back to see whether a wing is under-dressed all happen in the same sitting. It also now shares its unit conversion with the Heatmap tab, so a cell size and a measured distance are expressed in the same terms. How the distance labels stay legible against arbitrary level geometry.
